image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a Great White Pelican floating on dark, rippling water. The bird is facing left, with its head turned slightly towards the viewer. Its massive bill and gular pouch are prominent, showing pinkish-orange hues. The plumage is predominantly white with some visible darker flight feathers underneath the raised wing. The neck is curved, and the body sits low in the water.
